title: Self-supervised detection of atmospheric phenomena from remotely sensed synthetic aperture radar imagery

en.text: The European Space Agency's Sentinel-1 radar satellites have one very convenient property: they image the ocean with a C-band synthetic aperture radar (SAR) rather than visible light, so they see through clouds, day or night. Between the two spacecraft, they collect nearly 120,000 "Wave mode" (WV) images of the open ocean every month, each covering a 20 km by 20 km patch at 5 m resolution. Those images encode a rich mix of atmospheric and ocean-surface phenomena, including wind, turbulence, ocean fronts, and biological slicks, making them a valuable record for studying air-sea interaction and boundary-layer dynamics.

The catch is that teaching a machine to read these images is hard. Deep learning needs labeled training data, and SAR vignettes can only be annotated by trained experts, so labeling more than a few thousand images quickly becomes infeasible. Sparse labels have been the main obstacle to putting this enormous image stream to work.

At the ML4PS workshop at NeurIPS 2022, Yannik Glaser, Peter Sadowski, and Justin E. Stopa of the University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa asked a direct question: if labeled data is so scarce, can a model first teach itself useful representations from three million unlabeled Sentinel-1 images, and then be fine-tuned with the few labels that do exist? That is exactly the setting self-supervised contrastive learning is built for.

en.caption: Figure 1. Five representative SAR ocean scenes (each 20 × 20 km), ordered by atmospheric stability from unstable to stable: (a) strongly unstable micro-scale convective cells (MC); (b) mixed convection cells and wind streaks (MC/WS); (c) near-neutral wind streaks (WS); (d) stable, negligible variability (NV); and (e) a biological surface slick, labeled "other" (OT) in this study. Because these phenomena routinely coexist in a single scene, the authors switch to multi-label annotation.

en.text: Paper: https://ml4physicalsciences.github.io/2022/files/NeurIPS_ML4PS_2022_158.pdf
The problem: scarce labels, and a biased dataset on top

Earlier work by Stopa et al. classified SAR images into three surface-stability regimes, unstable, near-neutral, and stable, using the convolutional network of Wang et al. (referred to here as CmWV). That approach carried two structural flaws. First, its training set was cherry-picked: only exemplary images were kept for each class, so it did not reflect the true distribution of WV imagery. Second, the annotation protocol allowed only a single label per image, even though wind streaks, convective cells, and other phenomena often appear together in the same scene. The result was a training set that misrepresented the real ocean population.

The paper starts by rebuilding the benchmark on firmer ground: roughly 2,300 randomly sampled WV images, annotated by several experts into a consensus ground truth, with multiple labels allowed per image. The task focuses on four classes: micro-scale convective cells (MC), wind streaks (WS), negligible variability (NV), and other (OT). NV is defined as the absence of WS, MC, and any other phenomenon, while OT means no WS or MC but some other labeled phenomenon present. The dataset is split 60/20/20 into training, validation, and held-out test sets.
The method: learn a representation with SwAV, then probe it three ways

Contrastive self-supervised learning works by pulling different augmented views of the same image close together in representation space while pushing different images apart, all without human labels. The authors use SwAV (Swapping Assignments between multiple Views). Its neat trick is a clustering pretext task: representations are assigned to cluster centroids, and the network learns to predict one view's cluster assignment from another view. Where SimCLR needs prohibitively large batches, SwAV stores cluster assignments from past batches in a queue, so it can train at modest batch sizes and stays friendlier to limited compute.

A standard ResNet-50 backbone is trained with SwAV at batch size 1024 across 8 NVIDIA V100 32GB GPUs, with a queue of 16 batches and 1,000 cluster centroids, stopped after 65 epochs and about 10 days because of time and compute limits. Fine-tuning itself runs on a single V100 GPU at batch size 128. Once the unsupervised representation exists, how good is it? The authors answer with three downstream protocols of increasing depth, chosen precisely to separate the value of pretraining from the value of fine-tuning.

First, a weighted k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) classifier votes directly on the embeddings by Euclidean distance. With only one hyperparameter (k), it is a clean probe of representation quality. Second, linear evaluation freezes the entire ResNet and trains a single softmax layer on top of the frozen features. Third, end-to-end fine-tuning unfreezes all weights and trains the whole network on the labeled data. The last two protocols are run twice, once from ImageNet weights and once from SwAV weights, so the two initializations can be compared head to head.
The results: both crush the old model, but self-supervision doesn't beat ImageNet

There are two ways to read the numbers. Start with the representation itself. In the two protocols that keep the backbone frozen (kNN and linear evaluation), the self-supervised SwAV weights do hold a small edge over ImageNet: 0.864 versus 0.859 under kNN, and 0.841 versus 0.836 under linear evaluation. When the backbone is frozen, a representation learned on millions of SAR images carries a slight advantage.

en.caption: Table 1(a). Micro-averaged AUROC by evaluation protocol: kNN, Linear (linear evaluation), and Fine-tune (end-to-end). With the backbone frozen (kNN, Linear) the SwAV weights edge ahead; once the network is fine-tuned end to end, the ImageNet weights are slightly higher. Every gap is small.

en.text: But the model you actually deploy is the fine-tuned one, and here the comparison reverses. Once all weights are unfrozen and trained end to end, the ImageNet initialization comes out slightly ahead (0.931 versus 0.929), with a best micro-averaged AUROC of about 0.93. In other words, the small advantage from self-supervised pretraining disappears once the whole network is free to adapt.

Against the previous state of the art, though, the gains are real. On the two hardest atmospheric classes, both new models clearly beat CmWV regardless of initialization: wind streaks (WS) rise from CmWV's 0.727 to 0.831–0.850, and convective cells (MC) from 0.793 to 0.872–0.873. On stable, featureless ocean (NV) all three models are essentially tied, around 0.95. Because the label definitions and classes differ between the old and new datasets, the OT class cannot be compared with CmWV at all.

en.caption: Table 1(b). Per-class micro-averaged AUROC for the fine-tuned models. On the toughest classes, WS and MC, both new models far exceed the older CmWV; on NV the three are close; OT cannot be compared with CmWV because of differing label criteria (shown as –).

en.text: The takeaway: an honest first look

The most commendable thing about this paper is its honesty. The authors do not dress the result up as a win for self-supervision. They state plainly that in this initial study, contrastive learning offers only marginal gains over the far cheaper standard practice of transferring features from a model trained on natural images, while costing substantially more compute.

That is not a dismissal of the idea. The authors stress these are preliminary results: longer training, more extensive hyperparameter tuning, and pretext tasks designed specifically for remote sensing all remain unexplored, and any of them could be where self-supervision finally pays off. For a domain where annotation requires experts but unlabeled imagery is abundant, methods that can exploit that unlabeled stream remain genuinely valuable.

For downstream applications, there is a more immediate payoff. Whether you go the self-supervised route or the ImageNet-transfer route, detection accuracy jumps sharply over the previous state-of-the-art classifier. For scientific and environmental tasks that rely on SAR imagery to estimate ocean-surface stability automatically, a more reliable model means a more trustworthy pipeline, and that benefit is available today.

zh.text: 欧洲空间局的 Sentinel-1 雷达卫星有一个很省心的本事：它用 C 波段合成孔径雷达（SAR）成像，不靠可见光，因此白天黑夜、有云无云都能拍。它每个月能从全球开阔海面上获取近 120,000 张「波模式」（Wave mode，WV）影像，每张覆盖 20 公里 × 20 公里、分辨率 5 米。这些图像里藏着风、湍流、海洋锋面、生物膜等一系列大气与海面现象，是研究海气相互作用和边界层动力学的宝库。
问题在于，机器要「读懂」这些雷达图并不容易。深度学习方法离不开带标签的训练数据，而 SAR 图像的标注只能由受过训练的专家完成，标到几千张就已经是极限。标签稀缺，一直是把这批海量影像用起来的最大瓶颈。

夏威夷大学马诺阿分校（University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa）的 Yannik Glaser、Peter Sadowski 与 Justin E. Stopa 在 NeurIPS 2022 的 ML4PS 工作坊上提出一个直接的问题：既然带标签的数据这么少，能不能让模型先在三百万张无标签的 Sentinel-1 影像上「自学」表征，再用少量标注去微调？这正是自监督对比学习（self-supervised contrastive learning）擅长的场景。

zh.caption: 图1 五类典型 SAR 海面影像（每张 20 × 20 km），按大气稳定度从不稳定到稳定排列：(a) 强不稳定的微尺度对流单体（MC）；(b) 对流单体与风条纹共存（MC/WS）；(c) 近中性的风条纹（WS）；(d) 稳定、几乎无变化的海面（NV）；(e) 生物表面膜，在本研究中归为「其他」（OT）。这几类现象常常在同一片海面同时出现，正是本文改用多标签标注的原因。

zh.text: 论文地址：https://ml4physicalsciences.github.io/2022/files/NeurIPS_ML4PS_2022_158.pdf
问题：标签稀缺，而且旧数据集本身是「偏」的
此前，Stopa 等人用 Wang 等人的卷积网络模型（下文记作 CmWV）把 SAR 图像分成三类海面稳定度状态：不稳定、近中性、稳定。这套做法有两个结构性缺陷。其一，训练集是「挑」出来的，每一类只选了典型样本，并不能代表真实的 WV 影像分布。其二，标注协议规定每张图只能有一个标签，可现实中风条纹与对流单体等多种现象往往同时出现在同一张图里。结果就是一个不具代表性的数据集。

本文先从数据入手，重建了一个更可信的基准：约 2300 张随机采样的 WV 影像，由多位专家标注并形成共识标签，且允许多标签共存。任务聚焦四类——微尺度对流单体（MC）、风条纹（WS）、可忽略的大气变化（NV）、以及其他现象（OT）。其中 NV 定义为「不存在 WS、MC 及任何其他现象」，OT 则是「没有 WS 和 MC，但存在其他被标注的现象」。整个数据集按 60/20/20 分为训练、验证与留出测试集。
方法：先用 SwAV 自学表征，再用三种协议评估它

自监督对比学习的核心思路，是让同一张图的不同增强视图在表征空间里靠得更近，而不同图片彼此推远，整个过程不需要人工标签。本文采用的是 SwAV（Swapping Assignments between multiple Views）框架。它的巧妙之处在于用一个「聚类预测」的代理任务：把表征分配到若干聚类中心，再让网络从一个视图去预测另一个视图的聚类归属。相比 SimCLR 需要极大 batch，SwAV 通过把过往批次的聚类分配存进一个队列，可以在较小的 batch 下训练，对算力更友好。

作者用一个标准的 ResNet-50 作为骨干网络，以 batch size 1024、分布在 8 张 NVIDIA V100 32GB GPU 上、队列长度 16 个批次、1000 个聚类中心的配置训练 SwAV，因时间与算力所限在 65 个 epoch、约 10 天后停止。微调本身在单张 V100 GPU 上以 batch size 128 进行。得到无监督表征后，如何衡量它到底好不好？本文用了三种由浅入深的下游评估协议，来把「预训练本身的价值」与「微调带来的价值」区分开：

第一，加权 k 近邻（kNN）分类：直接在表征上按欧氏距离做最近邻投票，只有一个超参数 k，几乎不需要调参，是衡量表征质量最干净的探针。第二，线性评估（linear evaluation）：冻结整个 ResNet，只在表征之上训练一层 softmax 分类器。第三，端到端微调（fine-tuning）：解冻全部权重，在标注数据上整体训练。后两种协议都分别用 ImageNet 预训练权重和 SwAV 权重各跑一遍，以便对照。
结果：都大幅超越旧模型，但自监督并没有赢过 ImageNet
结果可以从两个角度看。先看表征本身：在不微调主干的两种协议里（kNN 与线性评估），SwAV 的自监督权重确实比 ImageNet 权重略好——kNN 上 0.864 对 0.859，线性评估上 0.841 对 0.836。这说明当骨干被冻住时，在海量 SAR 影像上自学的表征确实握有一点优势。

zh.caption: 表1(a) 不同评估协议下的 micro 平均 AUROC。评估协议：kNN、Linear（线性评估）、Fine-tune（端到端微调）。骨干冻结时（kNN、Linear）SwAV 权重略占优；一旦端到端微调，ImageNet 权重反而略高。所有差距都很小。

zh.text: 但真正拿来用的是微调后的模型，而这里的对比恰好反转：一旦解冻全部权重做端到端微调，ImageNet 初始化反而略微领先（0.931 对 0.929），最佳的 micro 平均 AUROC 约为 0.93。换句话说，自监督预训练的那点优势，在整个网络都被允许自适应之后就消失了。
不过，跟旧模型比，进步是实打实的。在两类最难的大气现象上，无论用哪种新权重都显著超过 CmWV：风条纹（WS）从 CmWV 的 0.727 提升到 0.831–0.850，对流单体（MC）从 0.793 提升到 0.872–0.873。而在稳定海面（NV）这一类上，三种模型旗鼓相当，都在 0.95 上下。由于新旧数据集的标注标准和类别不同，OT 类无法与 CmWV 直接比较。

zh.caption: 表1(b) 微调后模型在各单独类别上的 micro 平均 AUROC。SwAV 与 ImageNet 为两种权重初始化，CmWV 为旧的最先进模型。在最难的 WS 与 MC 两类上，新模型大幅超越 CmWV；NV 类三者接近；OT 类因标注口径不同无法与 CmWV 比较（记为 –）。

zh.text: 结论：一次诚实的初步探索
这篇论文最值得称道的地方，是它的诚实。作者没有把结论包装成「自监督大获全胜」，而是明确写道：在这次初步实验里，自监督对比学习相比「从自然图像迁移特征」这一更省事的标准做法，改进是边际的甚至并不存在，却要付出多得多的算力代价。
但这并不否定自监督的潜力。作者强调这些只是初步结果：更长的训练时间、更充分的超参数搜索、以及为遥感数据量身设计的代理任务，都还没来得及探索，而这些都可能是自监督真正发挥作用的关键。对于标注只能靠专家、数据却极其充裕的遥感领域来说，能利用海量无标签影像的半监督/自监督路线依然极具价值。
而对下游应用而言，一个更直接的收获是：无论走自监督还是 ImageNet 迁移这条路，检测精度都比旧的最先进模型有了大幅跃升。对于依赖 SAR 影像做海面稳定度自动分析的科学与环境任务，一个更可靠的模型意味着更可信的自动化流程——这一点，当下就能兑现。

en.caption: Figure 1. Five representative SAR ocean scenes (each 20 × 20 km), ordered by atmospheric stability from unstable to stable: (a) strongly unstable micro-scale convective cells (MC); (b) mixed convection cells and wind streaks (MC/WS); (c) near-neutral wind streaks (WS); (d) stable, negligible variability (NV); and (e) a biological surface slick, labeled "other" (OT) in this study. Because these phenomena routinely coexist in a single scene, the authors switch to multi-label annotation.

en.text: The method: learn a representation with SwAV, then probe it three ways

Contrastive self-supervised learning works by pulling different augmented views of the same image close together in representation space while pushing different images apart, all without human labels. The authors use SwAV (Swapping Assignments between multiple Views). Its neat trick is a clustering pretext task: representations are assigned to cluster centroids, and the network learns to predict one view's cluster assignment from another view. Where SimCLR needs prohibitively large batches, SwAV stores cluster assignments from past batches in a queue, so it can train at modest batch sizes and stays friendlier to limited compute.

A standard ResNet-50 backbone is trained with SwAV at batch size 1024 across 8 NVIDIA V100 32GB GPUs, with a queue of 16 batches and 1,000 cluster centroids, stopped after 65 epochs and about 10 days because of time and compute limits. Fine-tuning itself runs on a single V100 GPU at batch size 128. Once the unsupervised representation exists, how good is it? The authors answer with three downstream protocols of increasing depth, chosen precisely to separate the value of pretraining from the value of fine-tuning.

First, a weighted k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) classifier votes directly on the embeddings by Euclidean distance. With only one hyperparameter (k), it is a clean probe of representation quality. Second, linear evaluation freezes the entire ResNet and trains a single softmax layer on top of the frozen features. Third, end-to-end fine-tuning unfreezes all weights and trains the whole network on the labeled data. The last two protocols are run twice, once from ImageNet weights and once from SwAV weights, so the two initializations can be compared head to head.

zh.caption: 图1 五类典型 SAR 海面影像（每张 20 × 20 km），按大气稳定度从不稳定到稳定排列：(a) 强不稳定的微尺度对流单体（MC）；(b) 对流单体与风条纹共存（MC/WS）；(c) 近中性的风条纹（WS）；(d) 稳定、几乎无变化的海面（NV）；(e) 生物表面膜，在本研究中归为「其他」（OT）。这几类现象常常在同一片海面同时出现，正是本文改用多标签标注的原因。

zh.text: 方法：先用 SwAV 自学表征，再用三种协议评估它

自监督对比学习的核心思路，是让同一张图的不同增强视图在表征空间里靠得更近，而不同图片彼此推远，整个过程不需要人工标签。本文采用的是 SwAV（Swapping Assignments between multiple Views）框架。它的巧妙之处在于用一个「聚类预测」的代理任务：把表征分配到若干聚类中心，再让网络从一个视图去预测另一个视图的聚类归属。相比 SimCLR 需要极大 batch，SwAV 通过把过往批次的聚类分配存进一个队列，可以在较小的 batch 下训练，对算力更友好。

作者用一个标准的 ResNet-50 作为骨干网络，以 batch size 1024、分布在 8 张 NVIDIA V100 32GB GPU 上、队列长度 16 个批次、1000 个聚类中心的配置训练 SwAV，因时间与算力所限在 65 个 epoch、约 10 天后停止。微调本身在单张 V100 GPU 上以 batch size 128 进行。得到无监督表征后，如何衡量它到底好不好？本文用了三种由浅入深的下游评估协议，来把「预训练本身的价值」与「微调带来的价值」区分开：

第一，加权 k 近邻（kNN）分类：直接在表征上按欧氏距离做最近邻投票，只有一个超参数 k，几乎不需要调参，是衡量表征质量最干净的探针。第二，线性评估（linear evaluation）：冻结整个 ResNet，只在表征之上训练一层 softmax 分类器。第三，端到端微调（fine-tuning）：解冻全部权重，在标注数据上整体训练。后两种协议都分别用 ImageNet 预训练权重和 SwAV 权重各跑一遍，以便对照。

zh.title: NeurIPS 2022 | 三百万张卫星雷达图，能不能省下专家标注的力气？
zh.subtitle: 夏威夷大学团队用自监督对比学习读取 Sentinel-1 海面雷达影像，并诚实报告了它的边界

en.text: The European Space Agency's Sentinel-1 radar satellites have one very convenient property: they image the ocean with a C-band synthetic aperture radar (SAR) rather than visible light, so they see through clouds, day or night. Between the two spacecraft, they collect nearly 120,000 "Wave mode" (WV) images of the open ocean every month, each covering a 20 km by 20 km patch at 5 m resolution. Those images encode a rich mix of atmospheric and ocean-surface phenomena, including wind, turbulence, ocean fronts, and biological slicks, making them a valuable record for studying air-sea interaction and boundary-layer dynamics.

The catch is that teaching a machine to read these images is hard. Deep learning needs labeled training data, and SAR vignettes can only be annotated by trained experts, so labeling more than a few thousand images quickly becomes infeasible. Sparse labels have been the main obstacle to putting this enormous image stream to work.

At the ML4PS workshop at NeurIPS 2022, Yannik Glaser, Peter Sadowski, and Justin E. Stopa of the University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa asked a direct question: if labeled data is so scarce, can a model first teach itself useful representations from three million unlabeled Sentinel-1 images, and then be fine-tuned with the few labels that do exist? That is exactly the setting self-supervised contrastive learning is built for.

问题在于，机器要「读懂」这些雷达图并不容易。深度学习方法离不开带标签的训练数据，而 SAR 图像的标注只能由受过训练的专家完成，标到几千张就已经是极限。标签稀缺，一直是把这批海量影像用起来的最大瓶颈。

zh.title: NeurIPS 2022 | 三百万张卫星雷达图，能不能省下专家标注的力气？
zh.subtitle: 夏威夷大学团队用自监督对比学习读取 Sentinel-1 海面雷达影像，并诚实报告了它的边界

en.caption: Figure 1. Five representative SAR ocean scenes (each 20 × 20 km), ordered by atmospheric stability from unstable to stable: (a) strongly unstable micro-scale convective cells (MC); (b) mixed convection cells and wind streaks (MC/WS); (c) near-neutral wind streaks (WS); (d) stable, negligible variability (NV); and (e) a biological surface slick, labeled "other" (OT) in this study. Because these phenomena routinely coexist in a single scene, the authors switch to multi-label annotation.

en.text: The problem: scarce labels, and a biased dataset on top

Earlier work by Stopa et al. classified SAR images into three surface-stability regimes, unstable, near-neutral, and stable, using the convolutional network of Wang et al. (referred to here as CmWV). That approach carried two structural flaws. First, its training set was cherry-picked: only exemplary images were kept for each class, so it did not reflect the true distribution of WV imagery. Second, the annotation protocol allowed only a single label per image, even though wind streaks, convective cells, and other phenomena often appear together in the same scene. The result was a training set that misrepresented the real ocean population.

The paper starts by rebuilding the benchmark on firmer ground: roughly 2,300 randomly sampled WV images, annotated by several experts into a consensus ground truth, with multiple labels allowed per image. The task focuses on four classes: micro-scale convective cells (MC), wind streaks (WS), negligible variability (NV), and other (OT). NV is defined as the absence of WS, MC, and any other phenomenon, while OT means no WS or MC but some other labeled phenomenon present. The dataset is split 60/20/20 into training, validation, and held-out test sets.

zh.caption: 图1 五类典型 SAR 海面影像（每张 20 × 20 km），按大气稳定度从不稳定到稳定排列：(a) 强不稳定的微尺度对流单体（MC）；(b) 对流单体与风条纹共存（MC/WS）；(c) 近中性的风条纹（WS）；(d) 稳定、几乎无变化的海面（NV）；(e) 生物表面膜，在本研究中归为「其他」（OT）。这几类现象常常在同一片海面同时出现，正是本文改用多标签标注的原因。

zh.text: 问题：标签稀缺，而且旧数据集本身是「偏」的
此前，Stopa 等人用 Wang 等人的卷积网络模型（下文记作 CmWV）把 SAR 图像分成三类海面稳定度状态：不稳定、近中性、稳定。这套做法有两个结构性缺陷。其一，训练集是「挑」出来的，每一类只选了典型样本，并不能代表真实的 WV 影像分布。其二，标注协议规定每张图只能有一个标签，可现实中风条纹与对流单体等多种现象往往同时出现在同一张图里。结果就是一个不具代表性的数据集。

本文先从数据入手，重建了一个更可信的基准：约 2300 张随机采样的 WV 影像，由多位专家标注并形成共识标签，且允许多标签共存。任务聚焦四类——微尺度对流单体（MC）、风条纹（WS）、可忽略的大气变化（NV）、以及其他现象（OT）。其中 NV 定义为「不存在 WS、MC 及任何其他现象」，OT 则是「没有 WS 和 MC，但存在其他被标注的现象」。整个数据集按 60/20/20 分为训练、验证与留出测试集。

en.title: NeurIPS 2022: Can Three Million Satellite Radar Images Buy Their Way Out of the Labeling Bottleneck?
en.subtitle: A University of Hawai‘i team applies self-supervised contrastive learning to Sentinel-1 ocean radar, and reports honestly where it lands

zh.title: NeurIPS 2022 | 三百万张卫星雷达图，能不能省下专家标注的力气？
zh.subtitle: 夏威夷大学团队用自监督对比学习读取 Sentinel-1 海面雷达影像，并诚实报告了它的边界

en.caption: Figure 1. Five representative SAR ocean scenes (each 20 × 20 km), ordered by atmospheric stability from unstable to stable: (a) strongly unstable micro-scale convective cells (MC); (b) mixed convection cells and wind streaks (MC/WS); (c) near-neutral wind streaks (WS); (d) stable, negligible variability (NV); and (e) a biological surface slick, labeled "other" (OT) in this study. Because these phenomena routinely coexist in a single scene, the authors switch to multi-label annotation.

en.text: The results: both crush the old model, but self-supervision doesn't beat ImageNet

There are two ways to read the numbers. Start with the representation itself. In the two protocols that keep the backbone frozen (kNN and linear evaluation), the self-supervised SwAV weights do hold a small edge over ImageNet: 0.864 versus 0.859 under kNN, and 0.841 versus 0.836 under linear evaluation. When the backbone is frozen, a representation learned on millions of SAR images carries a slight advantage.

en.caption: Table 1(a). Micro-averaged AUROC by evaluation protocol: kNN, Linear (linear evaluation), and Fine-tune (end-to-end). With the backbone frozen (kNN, Linear) the SwAV weights edge ahead; once the network is fine-tuned end to end, the ImageNet weights are slightly higher. Every gap is small.

en.text: But the model you actually deploy is the fine-tuned one, and here the comparison reverses. Once all weights are unfrozen and trained end to end, the ImageNet initialization comes out slightly ahead (0.931 versus 0.929), with a best micro-averaged AUROC of about 0.93. In other words, the small advantage from self-supervised pretraining disappears once the whole network is free to adapt.

Against the previous state of the art, though, the gains are real. On the two hardest atmospheric classes, both new models clearly beat CmWV regardless of initialization: wind streaks (WS) rise from CmWV's 0.727 to 0.831–0.850, and convective cells (MC) from 0.793 to 0.872–0.873. On stable, featureless ocean (NV) all three models are essentially tied, around 0.95. Because the label definitions and classes differ between the old and new datasets, the OT class cannot be compared with CmWV at all.

en.caption: Table 1(b). Per-class micro-averaged AUROC for the fine-tuned models. On the toughest classes, WS and MC, both new models far exceed the older CmWV; on NV the three are close; OT cannot be compared with CmWV because of differing label criteria (shown as –).

en.text: The takeaway: an honest first look

The most commendable thing about this paper is its honesty. The authors do not dress the result up as a win for self-supervision. They state plainly that in this initial study, contrastive learning offers only marginal gains over the far cheaper standard practice of transferring features from a model trained on natural images, while costing substantially more compute.

That is not a dismissal of the idea. The authors stress these are preliminary results: longer training, more extensive hyperparameter tuning, and pretext tasks designed specifically for remote sensing all remain unexplored, and any of them could be where self-supervision finally pays off. For a domain where annotation requires experts but unlabeled imagery is abundant, methods that can exploit that unlabeled stream remain genuinely valuable.

For downstream applications, there is a more immediate payoff. Whether you go the self-supervised route or the ImageNet-transfer route, detection accuracy jumps sharply over the previous state-of-the-art classifier. For scientific and environmental tasks that rely on SAR imagery to estimate ocean-surface stability automatically, a more reliable model means a more trustworthy pipeline, and that benefit is available today.

zh.text: 问题：标签稀缺，而且旧数据集本身是「偏」的
此前，Stopa 等人用 Wang 等人的卷积网络模型（下文记作 CmWV）把 SAR 图像分成三类海面稳定度状态：不稳定、近中性、稳定。这套做法有两个结构性缺陷。其一，训练集是「挑」出来的，每一类只选了典型样本，并不能代表真实的 WV 影像分布。其二，标注协议规定每张图只能有一个标签，可现实中风条纹与对流单体等多种现象往往同时出现在同一张图里。结果就是一个不具代表性的数据集。

本文先从数据入手，重建了一个更可信的基准：约 2300 张随机采样的 WV 影像，由多位专家标注并形成共识标签，且允许多标签共存。任务聚焦四类——微尺度对流单体（MC）、风条纹（WS）、可忽略的大气变化（NV）、以及其他现象（OT）。其中 NV 定义为「不存在 WS、MC 及任何其他现象」，OT 则是「没有 WS 和 MC，但存在其他被标注的现象」。整个数据集按 60/20/20 分为训练、验证与留出测试集。
结果：都大幅超越旧模型，但自监督并没有赢过 ImageNet
结果可以从两个角度看。先看表征本身：在不微调主干的两种协议里（kNN 与线性评估），SwAV 的自监督权重确实比 ImageNet 权重略好——kNN 上 0.864 对 0.859，线性评估上 0.841 对 0.836。这说明当骨干被冻住时，在海量 SAR 影像上自学的表征确实握有一点优势。

zh.caption: 表1(a) 不同评估协议下的 micro 平均 AUROC。评估协议：kNN、Linear（线性评估）、Fine-tune（端到端微调）。骨干冻结时（kNN、Linear）SwAV 权重略占优；一旦端到端微调，ImageNet 权重反而略高。所有差距都很小。

zh.text: 但真正拿来用的是微调后的模型，而这里的对比恰好反转：一旦解冻全部权重做端到端微调，ImageNet 初始化反而略微领先（0.931 对 0.929），最佳的 micro 平均 AUROC 约为 0.93。换句话说，自监督预训练的那点优势，在整个网络都被允许自适应之后就消失了。
不过，跟旧模型比，进步是实打实的。在两类最难的大气现象上，无论用哪种新权重都显著超过 CmWV：风条纹（WS）从 CmWV 的 0.727 提升到 0.831–0.850，对流单体（MC）从 0.793 提升到 0.872–0.873。而在稳定海面（NV）这一类上，三种模型旗鼓相当，都在 0.95 上下。由于新旧数据集的标注标准和类别不同，OT 类无法与 CmWV 直接比较。

zh.caption: 表1(b) 微调后模型在各单独类别上的 micro 平均 AUROC。SwAV 与 ImageNet 为两种权重初始化，CmWV 为旧的最先进模型。在最难的 WS 与 MC 两类上，新模型大幅超越 CmWV；NV 类三者接近；OT 类因标注口径不同无法与 CmWV 比较（记为 –）。

Five representative SAR ocean scenes (each 20 × 20 km), ordered by atmospheric stability from unstable to stable: (a) strongly unstable micro-scale convective cells (MC); (b) mixed convection cells and wind streaks (MC/WS); (c) near-neutral wind streaks (WS); (d) stable, negligible variability (NV); and (e) a biological surface slick, labeled "other" (OT) in this study. Because these phenomena routinely coexist in a single scene, the authors switch to multi-label annotation.

en.text: The takeaway: an honest first look

The most commendable thing about this paper is its honesty. The authors do not dress the result up as a win for self-supervision. They state plainly that in this initial study, contrastive learning offers only marginal gains over the far cheaper standard practice of transferring features from a model trained on natural images, while costing substantially more compute.

That is not a dismissal of the idea. The authors stress these are preliminary results: longer training, more extensive hyperparameter tuning, and pretext tasks designed specifically for remote sensing all remain unexplored, and any of them could be where self-supervision finally pays off. For a domain where annotation requires experts but unlabeled imagery is abundant, methods that can exploit that unlabeled stream remain genuinely valuable.

For downstream applications, there is a more immediate payoff. Whether you go the self-supervised route or the ImageNet-transfer route, detection accuracy jumps sharply over the previous state-of-the-art classifier. For scientific and environmental tasks that rely on SAR imagery to estimate ocean-surface stability automatically, a more reliable model means a more trustworthy pipeline, and that benefit is available today.

zh.caption: 图1 五类典型 SAR 海面影像（每张 20 × 20 km），按大气稳定度从不稳定到稳定排列：(a) 强不稳定的微尺度对流单体（MC）；(b) 对流单体与风条纹共存（MC/WS）；(c) 近中性的风条纹（WS）；(d) 稳定、几乎无变化的海面（NV）；(e) 生物表面膜，在本研究中归为「其他」（OT）。这几类现象常常在同一片海面同时出现，正是本文改用多标签标注的原因。

zh.text: 结论：一次诚实的初步探索
这篇论文最值得称道的地方，是它的诚实。作者没有把结论包装成「自监督大获全胜」，而是明确写道：在这次初步实验里，自监督对比学习相比「从自然图像迁移特征」这一更省事的标准做法，改进是边际的甚至并不存在，却要付出多得多的算力代价。
但这并不否定自监督的潜力。作者强调这些只是初步结果：更长的训练时间、更充分的超参数搜索、以及为遥感数据量身设计的代理任务，都还没来得及探索，而这些都可能是自监督真正发挥作用的关键。对于标注只能靠专家、数据却极其充裕的遥感领域来说，能利用海量无标签影像的半监督/自监督路线依然极具价值。
而对下游应用而言，一个更直接的收获是：无论走自监督还是 ImageNet 迁移这条路，检测精度都比旧的最先进模型有了大幅跃升。对于依赖 SAR 影像做海面稳定度自动分析的科学与环境任务，一个更可靠的模型意味着更可信的自动化流程——这一点，当下就能兑现。

zh.title: NeurIPS 2022 | 三百万张卫星雷达图，能不能省下专家标注的力气？
zh.subtitle: 夏威夷大学团队用自监督对比学习读取 Sentinel-1 海面雷达影像，并诚实报告了它的边界

en.text: The European Space Agency's Sentinel-1 radar satellites have one very convenient property: they image the ocean with a C-band synthetic aperture radar (SAR) rather than visible light, so they see through clouds, day or night. Between the two spacecraft, they collect nearly 120,000 "Wave mode" (WV) images of the open ocean every month, each covering a 20 km by 20 km patch at 5 m resolution. Those images encode a rich mix of atmospheric and ocean-surface phenomena, including wind, turbulence, ocean fronts, and biological slicks, making them a valuable record for studying air-sea interaction and boundary-layer dynamics.

The catch is that teaching a machine to read these images is hard. Deep learning needs labeled training data, and SAR vignettes can only be annotated by trained experts, so labeling more than a few thousand images quickly becomes infeasible. Sparse labels have been the main obstacle to putting this enormous image stream to work.

At the ML4PS workshop at NeurIPS 2022, Yannik Glaser, Peter Sadowski, and Justin E. Stopa of the University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa asked a direct question: if labeled data is so scarce, can a model first teach itself useful representations from three million unlabeled Sentinel-1 images, and then be fine-tuned with the few labels that do exist? That is exactly the setting self-supervised contrastive learning is built for.

Because these phenomena routinely coexist in a single scene, the authors switch to multi-label annotation.
